The Subtask Name: Determine Wahab Riaz's batting handedness using multiple credible sources
Agents_edges:
- From_agent: Planner
  To_agent: WebSurfer
  agent_dependency_type: decision_dependency
  agent_strength: 0.90
  agent_explanation: The Planner analyzes the blocked ESPNcricinfo result and decides to re-engage the WebSurfer to gather data from alternative sources (Wikipedia, All Out Cricket, Cricket.com) to corroborate the batting style.
  agent_failure_modes:
    - type: loop_issue
      description: The Planner repeatedly instructs the WebSurfer to visit the same blocked URL (ESPNcricinfo) or the same Wikipedia page without adapting the strategy when access is denied, causing redundant steps.
      severity: 0.60
      if_from_agent_wrong: The Planner fails to recognize the access denial and continues to prioritize the blocked source over available alternatives.
      likely_effect_on_to_agent: The WebSurfer wastes time attempting to access blocked pages instead of gathering data from available sources like All Out Cricket.
    - type: data_issue
      description: The Planner may fail to extract the specific "Batting" field from the Wikipedia infobox visible in the viewport, leading to vague instructions for the WebSurfer.
      severity: 0.40
      if_from_agent_wrong: The Planner does not specify looking for the "Batting" line in the infobox.
      likely_effect_on_to_agent: The WebSurfer might miss the explicit "Right-handed" label in the infobox and only find it in the text body, reducing the precision of the extracted evidence.

- From_agent: WebSurfer
  To_agent: Planner
  agent_dependency_type: environment_feedback
  agent_strength: 0.85
  agent_explanation: The WebSurfer reports the "Access Denied" error from ESPNcricinfo and the content found on Wikipedia, providing the Planner with the necessary feedback to adjust the search strategy and select alternative sources.
  agent_failure_modes:
    - type: data_issue
      description: The WebSurfer might misinterpret the "Access Denied" page as a valid result or fail to clearly state that the specific URL is blocked, leading the Planner to believe the data is missing rather than inaccessible.
      severity: 0.70
      if_from_agent_wrong: The WebSurfer reports a successful access to ESPNcricinfo but provides no data, or claims the page is empty when it is actually blocked.
      likely_effect_on_to_agent: The Planner may proceed with reasoning based on non-existent data or fail to switch to alternative sources like All Out Cricket.

- From_agent: WebSurfer
  To_agent: Planner
  agent_dependency_type: environment_feedback
  agent_strength: 0.80
  agent_explanation: The WebSurfer provides search results from All Out Cricket and Wikipedia, confirming the batting style, allowing the Planner to synthesize the final answer.
  agent_failure_modes:
    - type: data_issue
      description: The WebSurfer might extract the "Bowling Style" (Left-arm fast) instead of the "Batting Style" (Right-handed) due to similar phrasing in the source text.
      severity: 0.85
      if_from_agent_wrong: The WebSurfer reports Wahab Riaz as a left-handed batsman.
      likely_effect_on_to_agent: The Planner will conclude incorrectly that Wahab Riaz is a left-handed batsman, leading to a wrong final answer.
